notes.text: Naskah final 193 kata, 8 segmen s1–s8, ≈77–83 dtk. Klaim Hulagu 2 juta, 40 hari, dan 'diinjak kuda' dibuang. ART_DIRECTION, STORYBOARD, ASSET_MANIFEST ditulis (Style: HISTORYMAP).

notes.text: s7: rig/Hud/BaghdadFilm/Root selesai, typecheck+smoke+preflight lolos, still per beat audit tanpa cap <4, cover-topic.png (3.5 dtk), docs/SHOTLIST.md, sfx.wav -28 LUFS 18 suara (G18c: VO -16 vs SFX -32 = 16 LU).

stages.name: Draf: contact sheet frame kunci (+ klip 15–20 dtk bila perlu) + audit visual
Gerbang render final (acc) → Final 1080×1920 @ 60 + QA audio/visual + outro AUDIRA
Caption 6 platform + jadwal upload + label AI (validator ok) + NOTES.md + tampil di chat + jadwalkan review (3 scheduled task)
Review pasca-tayang 24 jam / 72 jam / 7 hari (views, retensi, hook) → NOTES.md
